overview: A modern, high-converting personal portfolio landing page for Poonam Thakur — Web & Application Developer and AI Enthusiast. Features a hero section with tech badges, skills grid, project showcase, and contact form with a clean white and dark blue design.
features: Hero section with headline, subtext, and call-to-action buttons
Tech stack badges (React.js, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, HTML, CSS)
Skills grid organized by category with icons
Project cards with hover effects for 3 portfolio projects
Contact form with email link and Hire Me CTA
Footer with LinkedIn placeholder and copyright
